description: §22.12 (S459 round 4 F1) — the insertion point is inside a page `<form>`: an injected hidden input would join that form's submission. Refused: nothing written.
rationale: §22.12 *Insertion inside a page form*: a form-associated control anywhere in the parsed tree is a violation when the insertion point has a `<form>` ancestor. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
